record.paper_title: Open problems posed at the tenth International conference on fuzzy set theory and applications (FSTA 2010, Liptovsky Jan, Slovakia)
record.original_question: For n-ary semicopulas S on [0,1]^n, characterize the class G consisting of those S whose S-volume is nonnegative for every n-dimensional Cartesian interval whose top vertex is the top vertex of the unit hypercube [0,1]^n. Also characterize natural distinguished subclasses of G.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 2$. An $n$-ary semicopula is a function $S:[0,1]^n\to[0,1]$ such that:
(i) $S(x_1,\dots,x_n)=0$ whenever $x_i=0$ for some $i$;
(ii) $S(1,\dots,1,x_i,1,\dots,1)=x_i$ for every $i$ and every $x_i\in[0,1]$ (each variable is neutral at $1$);
(iii) $S$ is nondecreasing in each variable.

For an $n$-dimensional Cartesian interval $R=\prod_{i=1}^n[a_i,b_i]\subseteq[0,1]^n$ with $a_i\le b_i$, the $S$-volume of $R$ is
$$V_S(R)=\sum_{\varepsilon\in\{0,1\}^n}(-1)^{n-\sum_i\varepsilon_i}\, S\bigl(c_1(\varepsilon_1),\dots,c_n(\varepsilon_n)\bigr),$$
where $c_i(0)=a_i$ and $c_i(1)=b_i$.

Let $\mathcal G$ denote the class of all $n$-ary semicopulas $S$ such that $V_S(R)\ge 0$ for every $n$-dimensional Cartesian interval $R=\prod_{i=1}^n[a_i,1]\subseteq[0,1]^n$ whose top vertex equals the top vertex $(1,1,\dots,1)$ of the unit hypercube.

Problem: Provide an intrinsic characterization of the class $\mathcal G$, and characterize natural distinguished subclasses of $\mathcal G$ (for example, those obtained by imposing additional symmetry, continuity, associativity, or Lipschitz-type conditions).
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search for "top-vertex-positive semicopulas" and related characterization results did not return any publication explicitly resolving this problem. The general theory of semicopulas (Durante–Quesada-Molina–Sempi, Kybernetika 2006, and subsequent literature) characterizes various related subclasses but no source confirms a full characterization of the class G of top-vertex-positive n-ary semicopulas. Status is therefore taken as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Semicopulas: characterizations and applicability
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizations of various subclasses of semicopulas are discussed, but the top-vertex-positivity condition for n-ary semicopulas is not addressed.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational characterizations of semicopulas exist but do not cover the specific class G described in the problem.

status_evidence.title: Semicopulæ (EUDML)
status_evidence.snippet: General theory of semicopulas as binary aggregation operators with neutral element 1.
status_evidence.claim: Background reference; no resolution of the top-vertex-positive characterization problem found.
